title: display: flex
description: The flex layout mode is not honoured by the Word rendering engine, which collapses the container to a block.

title: gap
description: The gap property is ignored outside a supported flex or grid container, leaving elements flush against each other.

title: border-radius
description: Rounded corners fall back to square ones; use a VML rounded rectangle if the shape matters.

title: linear-gradient()
description: The gradient is dropped entirely; always set a solid background-color first so the panel is not left transparent.

title: <font> element
description: The font element is deprecated in HTML5 and is rewritten or dropped by some webmail sanitisers.

title: bgcolor attribute on <body>
description: Webmail clients that strip the body element lose the background colour with it; wrap the mail in a full-width table instead.

title: -apple-system font stack
description: The system font keyword is not recognised and the declaration falls through to the next family in the stack.
